tagline: Restoring American Leadership in Rare Earth Materials
hero_kpi_rationale: The NdPr oxide production KPI is the key driver for the company, representing the primary revenue source and being essential for the production of materials used in high-tech applications and electric vehicles.

kpis.name: NdPr Oxide Production
kpis.explanation: NdPr oxide production is a key component of materials used in high-tech applications.
kpis.description: NdPr oxide production is essential for the company, representing the primary revenue source for the Materials segment.
kpis.signal: NdPr oxide production reached a record of 2,599 MT in 2025, an increase of 101% compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Magnetics Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Magnetics segment comes from the sale of magnetic products and magnetic precursor products.
kpis.description: Magnetics segment revenue is a key indicator of growth in the company's manufacturing division.
kpis.signal: The Magnetics segment generated $66.9 million in revenue in its first year of substantial operations.

kpis.name: Materials Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Materials segment comes from the sale of rare earth oxides and metals, primarily NdPr oxide and metal.
kpis.description: Materials segment revenue reflects sales of refined rare earth products, impacted by the strategic decision to cease sales in China.
kpis.signal: Materials segment revenue declined 21% year-over-year in 2025 following the halt of sales in China in July 2025.

kpis.name: NdFeB Magnet Production
kpis.explanation: Production of NdFeB (neodymium-iron-boron) permanent magnets at the Independence Facility began in December 2025, marking a key milestone in the development of the American magnetic supply chain.
kpis.description: NdFeB magnet production represents a critical new revenue stream for the company, enabling vertical integration of the rare earth supply chain.
kpis.signal: NdFeB magnet production commenced in December 2025 at the Independence Facility

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks and Commercial Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company ceased all product sales to China in July 2025 following an agreement with the U.S. Department of Defense. This strategic decision reduced Materials segment revenue by 21% year-over-year. Chinese export controls on rare earths represent an ongoing risk to alternative supply chains. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Rare Earth Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Rare earth prices can fluctuate due to global supply and demand dynamics, as well as geopolitical factors. Although the company has secured a price protection agreement with the U.S. Department of Defense guaranteeing a floor of $110/kg for NdPr, this protection is limited to approximately ten years. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for heavy rare earths (HREE) and other raw materials necessary for magnet production. The production capacity of the new 10X Facility and HREE supply are critical to fulfilling commitments with the U.S. Department of Defense. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition and Market Position
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increasing competition in the rare earth and magnet manufacturing sector, particularly from established Asian producers with potentially lower production costs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly regulated industry and must comply with strict environmental standards at federal, state, and local levels. Expansion projects (10X Facility, HREE expansion, recycling facilities) involve regulatory compliance risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Capital Project Execution Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has committed up to $600 million in capital to build the 10X Facility, expand the Independence Facility, and develop HREE capabilities. Delays or cost overruns could impact profitability and the ability to meet EBITDA guarantees with the U.S. Department of Defense. (default score, to be refined)
